probe.cost_ceiling_scope: total corrected moves from the decision source
probe.local_g: replayed candidate prefix cost from the decision state
probe.deal_slot: reserve the eighth slot when Deal is legal and outside the first eight
probe.unfinished_witness: executable as ordering evidence, not a minimum certificate

episode.alternation: even root index baseline then witness; odd root index witness then baseline

metric.dominance: at least as many foundations AND no more hidden cards, with one strict improvement
metric.complete_solution: a full independently replayed eight-foundation solution outranks an incomplete position
metric.stock_alone: fewer stock cards alone is not a win
metric.mixed: mixed foundation and reveal changes are tradeoffs
metric.trajectory: equal reveal-count milestone costs are observed trajectory costs, not optimal costs
metric.signal: at least two nonduplicate roots favour witness mode; no paired root is dominated by baseline; legality, cost, and provenance checks pass
metric.signal_scope: within-deal practical-play signal only; no generalisation, finishability, or complete-solve claim
metric.no_clear_benefit: insufficient wins, ties, tradeoffs, capped runs, or baseline regressions
metric.correctness_blocker: illegal execution, source or witness mismatch, broken accounting, or a false provenance or certainty claim
metric.escape_progress: foundations or hidden cards improve without worsening the other; stock count and extra actions are not progress
metric.escape_benefit: at least two warm roots improve on that rule and no pair regresses or trades off
metric.escape_only: a correct fallback recovery without that benefit is ESCAPE_ONLY_NO_CLEAR_GAME_BENEFIT

cycle_escape.trigger: single original-action fallback whose one-step destination was already reached at an equal or lower corrected g
cycle_escape.order: existing full PR3 order, including unprobed actions and Deal
cycle_escape.accept: first affordable successor that is unseen or arrives at a strictly lower g

recommendation: Leave the default cycle guard unchanged. The opt-in escape did not show a clear foundation or hidden-card benefit.
